other_failure_modes.name: Target truncation via astype(int)
other_failure_modes.description: The target column in the Jigsaw dataset is a continuous toxicity score between 0.0 and 1.0. By casting directly to integer via `astype(int)`, all values strictly less than 1.0 are truncated to 0, effectively wiping out the vast majority of positive labels. The standard approach is to threshold at 0.5 (e.g., `(target >= 0.5).astype(int)`).

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates submission IDs using `np.arange(len(test))` rather than extracting the `id` column from the test dataset. If the test set uses specific ID values (as is typical in Kaggle competitions), this will result in mismatched IDs and an evaluation failure.

summary: The agent correctly implements a cross-validated LightGBM pipeline with text features, TF-IDF, and TruncatedSVD, successfully avoiding data leakage. However, it introduces two critical execution flaws: incorrectly truncating the continuous target probabilities to integers (destroying the labels) and hardcoding submission IDs (which will likely break the evaluation scoring).
